issue.body:
PR #34934 switched the `getting-started` docs example from using the index of a product in the `products` array to using the product's ID property for indentifiying each product in the `ProductDetailsComponent` component. However, some necessary changes in the example code and the `start-routing.md` guide were missed in #34934, resulting in broken instructions for the readers (see #40189).

This PR is essentially a follow-up to #34934, making the remaining changes in the example code and the guide instructions.

Fixes #40189.

##
This PR also includes some refactorings and clean-ups for the `getting-started`/`getting-started-v0` docs examples. See individual commits for more details.

body:
Good catch! Thx for reporting this, @Kovoltcher :+1:

This seems to be an artifact from back when we used the `products` array index to identify each product.
#40197 should take care of making the remaining changes to fully switch the examples to using `product.id`.

Thanks @gkalpak.
I'm glad that I could help, especially because I'm relativly new to coding. I realy like the Tutorial, keep up the good work 🥇

issue.body:
# 📚 Docs or angular.io bug report

### Description

This part of the tutorial asks a user to create a For loop to dynamically create an Id value for each item in products.ts
however, the Id value is not created by following the steps in the tutorial and so the app fails to load information about each product when you click through to their individual pages.

Manually adding an Id variable to each of the products in products.ts resolves the issue, but does not allow a user to dynamically set the value with a For loop.


## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction

### What's the affected URL?**
https://angular.io/start/start-routing

## 🔥 Exception or Error

Property 'id' does not exist on type '{ name: string; price: number; description: string; }'.

Found in file: product-details.component.ts when inspecting this line: return product.id === Number(productIdFromRoute);
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/60511512/102912418-45edb200-4475-11eb-9d2b-1e15eb1d3add.png)
